title: Route ordinary documentation work away from skill authoring
prompt: Update the project README to explain how contributors should name API endpoints. This is ordinary project documentation; do not create or revise a reusable skill.
expected_behaviors: Recognize the requested artifact as ordinary project documentation, not a reusable skill.
Do not invoke the full skill-authoring rubric or create evaluation cases.
Keep the requested documentation change limited to endpoint naming guidance.
must_not: Create or edit a SKILL.md file.
Create a skill-quality score or evaluation case set.
Expand the request into toolkit-wide skill maintenance.
